battle.name: 厄立特里亞獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 厄立特里亞北部與阿斯馬拉
battle.brief: 厄立特里亞獨立戰爭於一九六一年九月展開，是厄立特里亞民族解放陣線反抗衣索比亞統治、爭取獨立的武裝衝突。英國海軍於一八六五年服役的蒸汽鐵甲艦（Steam ironclad）屬遠洋重裝甲艦種，在海軍體系中負責巡弋、封鎖與制海。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦是英國皇家海軍在一八六〇年代艦隊中的重裝甲主力艦種，憑藉裝甲與重砲執行遠洋巡弋、封鎖及制海任務。

countries: 1961年9月1日爆發的戰爭，交戰主體一端是由開羅成立的厄立特里亞解放陣線（ELF）及其後續政軍組織，另一端是1961至1974年的埃塞俄比亞帝國軍與1974至1991年掌權的「軍委」政府軍。1971年，ELF與厄立特里亞解放運動（ELM）合併為厄立特里亞人民解放陣線（EPLF）；1969年分出的「穆斯林聯盟」先以厄立特里亞伊斯蘭解放運動名義活動，1980年改組為厄立特里亞解放陣線（OLF），並在西部低地和西部高原維持另一套武裝。EPLF與OLF多數時候並肩對抗埃塞俄比亞，但兩者的政治目標、訓練方式與對外援助來源並不相同，不能合併視為單一軍隊。英國在1961年仍管理部分治安與通訊，初期襲擊因此也針對殖民警察與鐵路、郵電節點；以色列曾在1960年代向埃塞俄比亞提供武器與軍事協助。1970年代後期起，蘇聯與古巴向軍委政府提供大量軍援，鄰近的蘇丹與索馬利亞則在不同時期提供邊境通行、補給或庇護。聯合國持續把厄立特里亞列為議題，卻沒有建立能迫使各方停火的國際部隊。
countriesEn: The conflict that began on 1 September 1961 had, on one side, the Eritrean Liberation Front (ELF), founded in Cairo, and the political-military organizations that followed it. On the other were the armed forces of the Ethiopian Empire from 1961 to 1974 and the army of the Provisional Military Administrative Council, or Derg, government from 1974 to 1991. In 1971, the ELF and the Eritrean Liberation Movement (ELM) merged to form the Eritrean People's Liberation Front (EPLF). The Muslim League that split from the ELF in 1969 first operated under the name Eritrean Islamic Liberation Movement and reorganized as the Eritrean Liberation Front (OLF) in 1980, maintaining a separate force in the western lowlands and western highlands. The EPLF and OLF usually fought Ethiopia alongside one another, but their political aims, training methods, and sources of foreign assistance differed, so they cannot be treated as a single army. Britain still administered some security and communications functions in 1961, and the earliest attacks therefore targeted colonial police, railway, and postal and telegraph installations. Israel supplied Ethiopia with arms and military assistance during the 1960s. From the late 1970s, the Soviet Union and Cuba provided extensive military aid to the Derg government, while Sudan and Somalia offered border access, supplies, or sanctuary at different times. The United Nations kept Eritrea on its agenda but never created an international force capable of compelling the parties to stop fighting.
people: 這場戰爭不能只歸因於一名將領，必須按階段分辨人物的作用。伊德里斯・穆罕默德・亞當（Idris Muhammad Adam）參與1960年在開羅創立ELF，長期擔任其政治領袖與對外聯絡人；奧斯曼・薩萊赫・薩貝（Osman Saleh Sabbe）於1961年加入後出任早期軍事參謀長，負責把鬆散武裝小組整理成能受指揮、分散行動的隊伍；拉馬丹・穆罕默德・努爾（Ramadan Mohammed Nur）是哈姆西恩地區的重要野戰指揮官，長期處理小隊突擊、撤退與跨境補給；特沃爾德・貝爾漢・加布雷・埃格齊亞貝爾（Tewolde Berhan Gebre Egziabher）由基層戰鬥員升為EPLF中央委員及高級指揮官。1971年合併的關鍵組織者阿斯法沃・沃森（Asfaw Wossen）在1970年代先後主持EPLF政治與軍事機關，戰後進入臨時政府；伊薩亞斯・阿夫韋里克（Isaias Afwerik）1970年加入EPLF，1985至1988年任人民解放軍參謀長，1989年出任EPLF主席並指揮末期攻勢。埃塞俄比亞方面，海萊・塞拉西一世（Haile Selassie I）代表1961至1974年的帝國政府，1974年以後則由軍委主席孟吉斯圖・海萊・馬里安（Mengistu Haile Mariam）承擔政權存亡與北部戰爭的決策。謝赫・易卜拉欣・謝赫（Sheikh Ibrahim al-Sheikh）是1969年後穆斯林聯盟的主要領導者，其組織路線後來成為OLF的基礎。
peopleEn: The war cannot be attributed to a single commander, and the roles of its leaders must be distinguished by period. Idris Muhammad Adam helped found the ELF in Cairo in 1960 and served for many years as its political leader and diplomatic representative. Osman Saleh Sabbe joined in 1961 and served as an early chief of staff, organizing loosely connected armed groups into units capable of receiving orders and operating in dispersed formations. Ramadan Mohammed Nur was an important field commander in Hamasien and handled small-unit attacks, withdrawals, and cross-border supply over many years. Tewolde Berhan Gebre Egziabher rose from a rank-and-file fighter to a senior commander and member of the EPLF central committee. Asfaw Wossen, a principal organizer of the 1971 merger, headed EPLF political and military institutions in the 1970s and later joined the provisional government. Isaias Afwerik joined the EPLF in 1970, served as chief of staff of the People's Liberation Army from 1985 to 1988, became chairman of the EPLF in 1989, and directed the final offensive. On the Ethiopian side, Haile Selassie I represented the imperial government from 1961 to 1974; after 1974, Derg chairman Mengistu Haile Mariam assumed responsibility for regime survival and the war in the north. Sheikh Ibrahim al-Sheikh was the principal leader of the post-1969 Muslim League, and his organizational line later formed the basis of the OLF.
kits: 雙方裝備隨年代而變，不能把整場戰爭寫成同一套武器。1961年的起義小組常取得英國、義大利與後來政府軍留下的零散武器，包括李-恩菲爾德步槍（Lee-Enfield No.4）、義大利卡爾卡諾M91步槍（Carcano M91）、貝雷塔M1938短步槍（Beretta M1938）、布侖輕機槍（Bren）、斯特林衝鋒槍（Sterling）、英制二英寸迫擊炮，以及義大利制式六五毫米與七五毫米.pack gun。小組以騾馬、步行運輸和吉普車轉移物資，1960年問世的豐田FJ40（Toyota FJ40）與1958年的Land Rover Series II都可承擔偵察及聯絡。埃塞俄比亞帝國軍除沿用英、義武器，也使用美制M1一五五毫米榴彈炮與M2一〇五毫米榴彈炮；1974年以後，蘇聯制AK-47、AKM、PKM輕機槍、RPG-2火箭筒、八一毫米M1迫擊炮、八二毫米PM-36迫擊炮、D-30一二二毫米榴彈炮、ZIL-157卡車、T-54與T-55坦克、MiG-15、MiG-17、MiG-21戰鬥機及一九六一年開始服役的ZU-二三毫米自動炮逐漸進入軍委軍序列。實際作戰最棘手的是彈藥與維修：英制三〇三、蘇制七點六二和義制步槍口徑不能互換，八一與八二毫米迫擊炮也分屬不同供應線；卡車輪胎、柴油、牽引設備與坦克備件一旦被截斷，前線火力便難以持續。
kitsEn: Equipment on both sides changed over time, so the entire war cannot be described as a single standardized arsenal. The insurgent cells of 1961 often obtained scattered weapons left by British, Italian, and later Ethiopian forces, including the Lee-Enfield No.4 rifle, Italian Carcano M91 rifle, Beretta M1938 carbine, Bren light machine gun, Sterling submachine gun, British two-inch mortar, and Italian 65 mm and 75 mm pack guns. Small groups moved supplies with pack animals, porters, and jeeps; the Toyota FJ40, introduced in 1960, and the 1958 Land Rover Series II could be used for reconnaissance and liaison. The imperial Ethiopian army continued British, Italian, and American weapons, including the American M1 155 mm howitzer and M2 105 mm howitzer. After 1974, Soviet AK-47 and AKM rifles, PKM light machine guns, RPG-2 launchers, 81 mm M1 and 82 mm PM-36 mortars, D-30 122 mm howitzers, ZIL-157 trucks, T-54 and T-55 tanks, MiG-15, MiG-17, and MiG-21 fighters, and the ZU-23 23 mm automatic gun, which entered service in 1961, gradually entered the Derg army's inventory. The most difficult operational problems were ammunition and maintenance. British .303, Soviet 7.62 mm, and Italian rifle ammunition were not interchangeable, while 81 mm and 82 mm mortars belonged to separate supply systems. Loss of truck tires, diesel, towing equipment, or tank spares could immediately reduce combat effectiveness on a front.
tactics: 初期ELF採取小隊游擊，而不是佔領固定城市：隊員在夜間接近目標，攻擊殖民警察哨、凱倫一帶的鐵路與通訊設施、阿戈達特等地的軍政據點，奪取彈藥或文件後即撤回山地。帝國軍以據點控制道路、派遣武裝柱掃清鄉間，並利用道路與航空進行搜索；1967至1968年的「陽光行動」（Operation Sunshine）一度迫使起義力量退出西部低地的主要城鎮，卻未能摧毀其基幹，隊伍遂向哈姆西恩山區、阿克萊古宰及塞米恩納維德凱姆哈雷方向轉移。1970年代，EPLF曾以集中步兵和炮兵進攻城鎮及交通線，也因連續營地、彈藥不足和正面火力集中而受挫；PLA重新恢復分散、機動與夜襲，保存兵力。1980年代，PLA已能以營級突擊群配合炮兵 assault固定陣地，伏擊由步兵、坦克與工兵護衛的政府軍車隊，並利用RPG-2打擊裝甲目標。地形使這種戰法有效：阿法貝特平原開闊，適合裝甲車作戰；凱倫、阿斯馬拉至馬薩瓦公路、納克法、納庫拉與恩巴德爾霍一帶則有山口、峽谷和石質高地可供防守。政府軍從亞的斯亞貝巴經梅克勒、阿迪凱伊向阿斯馬拉輸送補給，PLA則破壞其縱隊、奪取車輛，並把西線壓力交給OLF。1988年政府軍「紅海行動」在凱倫正面受挫後，PLA與OLF分別從東面高地和西部低地施壓，最終使政府軍無法恢復對北部走廊的控制。
tacticsEn: At first, the ELF used small-unit guerrilla tactics rather than trying to hold cities. Fighters approached targets at night, attacked colonial police posts, railway and communications installations around Keren, and military or administrative posts at places such as Agordat, and then withdrew into the mountains with ammunition or documents. The imperial army answered with fixed posts, road control, armed columns, and aerial and road-based searches. Operation Sunshine in 1967 and 1968 forced the insurgents out of the main western lowland towns for a time, but it did not destroy their organization, and the fighters shifted their bases toward the Hamasien mountains, Akele Guzai, and Semienawi Dekemhare. During the 1970s, the EPLF sometimes concentrated infantry and artillery against towns and transport lines, but continuous positions, ammunition shortages, and exposed concentrations of firepower brought severe defeats; the PLA therefore returned to dispersed movement, maneuver, and night attacks to preserve its forces. By the 1980s, the PLA could combine battalion-level assault groups with artillery against fixed positions, ambush government columns protected by tanks and engineers, and use RPG-2 launchers against armored vehicles. Terrain made these methods effective. The Afabet plain favored armored maneuver, while Keren, the Asmara–Massawa road, Nakfa, Nakura, and Emba Derho offered passes, ravines, and rocky heights suitable for defense. Government supply moved from Addis Ababa through Mekelle and Adi Keyh to Asmara. The PLA attacked those columns, captured vehicles, and transferred sustained pressure in the west to the OLF. After the government offensive Operation Red Sea was checked on the Keren axis in 1988, the EPLF and OLF applied pressure from the eastern highlands and western lowlands respectively, preventing the government from restoring control of the northern corridor.
data: 可核對的時間骨架如下：1961年9月1日，ELF在西部低地發動最初數次襲擊，戰爭由政治組織轉為武裝衝突；同年英國結束在厄立特里亞的行政使命，1962年海萊・塞拉西一世解散聯邦，把厄立特里亞改為埃塞俄比亞的一個省份。1967至1968年，帝國軍實施「陽光行動」，主要城鎮一度由政府軍重奪。1969年ELF發生分裂，1971年ELF與ELM合併成立EPLF；1974年海萊・塞拉西一世被廢黜，軍委掌權並獲得愈來愈大的蘇聯與古巴軍援。1977至1978年，政府軍在「約爾達諾斯行動」（Operation Yordanos）中以師級部隊進攻北部山區，未能消滅PLA主力。1986年1月，PLA進入阿斯馬拉大部分市區，但機場與北向公路仍是政府軍據守和對峙地點；1987年軍委政權正式使用埃塞俄比亞人民民主共和國之名。1980年代中期至1988年間，政府軍在納庫拉與恩巴德爾霍方向的攻勢屢受挫敗，1988年的「紅海行動」也未能打通凱倫正面，PLA隨後反攻並於1989年控制凱倫；到1990年，馬薩瓦與阿薩布一帶的最後政府軍據點亦失守或撤離。1991年5月24日，PLA攻占阿斯馬拉最後的政府軍陣地，厄立特里亞臨時政府成立，實戰至此結束。1993年4月23至25日舉行公民投票，官方結果為贊成獨立百分之九十九點八、投票率百分之九十四點七；同年5月24日正式宣布獨立，5月28日獲聯合國接納。各方公布的三十年傷亡總數缺乏一致口徑，無法負責任地加成一個精確數字。
dataEn: The verifiable chronological framework is as follows. On 1 September 1961, the ELF launched its first attacks in the western lowlands, turning a political organization into an armed movement. Britain ended its Eritrean administrative mission that year, and in 1962 Haile Selassie I dissolved the federation and made Eritrea a province of Ethiopia. The imperial army conducted Operation Sunshine in 1967 and 1968, temporarily recovering the principal towns. The ELF split in 1969, and the ELF and ELM merged to establish the EPLF in 1971. Haile Selassie I was removed in 1974, after which the Derg assumed power and received increasingly extensive Soviet and Cuban assistance. During Operation Yordanos in 1977 and 1978, government forces mounted divisional attacks in the northern highlands but failed to destroy the PLA's main forces. In January 1986, PLA forces entered most of urban Asmara, although the airport and the road north remained government strongpoints and zones of confrontation. In 1987, the Derg state formally adopted the name Ethiopian People's Democratic Republic. Between the mid-1980s and 1988, government offensives toward Nakura and Emba Derho were checked, and Operation Red Sea in 1988 also failed to break through on the Keren axis. The PLA counterattacked and took control of Keren in 1989. By 1990, the last government positions around Massawa and Assab had fallen or been evacuated. On 24 May 1991, the PLA captured the remaining government positions in Asmara and the provisional government of Eritrea was established, bringing effective fighting to an end. A referendum was held from 23 to 25 April 1993; official results recorded 99.8 percent approval for independence and a 94.7 percent turnout. Eritrea formally declared independence on 24 May and was admitted to the United Nations on 28 May. The belligerents' published casualty totals for three decades of fighting lack consistent definitions and cannot responsibly be combined into one precise number.
cause: 戰爭源於一連串政治與制度變化，而不只是邊界糾紛。義大利在1941年失去厄立特里亞後，該地成為英國管理的聯合國託管地；1952年，厄立特里亞與埃塞俄比亞組成聯邦，聯邦中央一級掌握國防、外交與重要任命，厄立特里亞地方政治人物因缺乏完整自治權而要求結束由埃塞俄比亞主導的聯邦體制。1962年，海萊・塞拉西一世在未先取得厄立特里亞方面同意的情況下解散聯邦，將其併入王國行政體系，使原本可由制度改革處理的衝突轉為武裝鬥爭。ELF初期具有跨越宗教與地區的廣泛聯合，ELM採較明確的馬克思列寧主義組織路線，1969年分出的穆斯林聯盟則以伊斯蘭政治動員為特色；組織分裂、外部援助與領導競爭從此削弱了起義陣營的整體性。埃塞俄比亞帝國政府把武裝行動視為分裂國家與危害主權，1974年後的軍委則把北部戰線視為政權存亡問題，因而投入常備師、坦克、炮兵與空軍。冷戰格局又使地區衝突得到外部支持，使原本可能因談判而改變的戰線長期維持。
causeEn: The war arose from a sequence of political and institutional changes rather than a simple border dispute. After Italy lost Eritrea in 1941, the territory became a United Nations trust territory administered by Britain. In 1952, Eritrea and Ethiopia formed a federation, but the federal center retained control of defense, foreign affairs, and important appointments. Eritrean political figures, frustrated by the absence of full self-government, sought to end a system dominated by Ethiopia. In 1962, Haile Selassie I dissolved the federation without first obtaining Eritrean agreement and incorporated the territory into the kingdom's administrative system, turning a dispute that might have been addressed through institutional reform into armed struggle. The original ELF included a broad coalition across religious and regional lines. The ELM followed a more explicitly Marxist-Leninist organizational line, while the Muslim League that split away in 1969 relied on Islamic political mobilization. Organizational division, foreign patronage, and competition for leadership consequently weakened the insurgent movement as a whole. The imperial Ethiopian government treated the armed campaign as secession and a threat to sovereignty. After 1974, the Derg regarded the northern front as a question of regime survival and committed standing divisions, tanks, artillery, and air power. The Cold War then supplied external support to the region, keeping a front line active that political negotiations might otherwise have closed.
impact: 軍事上，這場戰爭把原本分散、短命的游擊小組改造成能持續作戰數十年的PLA。早期ELM與ELF的合併，使政令、軍事指揮、 後勤和外交接洽逐漸集中；到末期，PLA已能部署營級突擊、炮兵支援、裝甲反擊與奪取裝備的連續行動，OLF則在西部建立另一支以機動游擊和突擊城鎮為主的隊伍。埃塞俄比亞同樣被戰爭改造，帝國軍由主要依賴步兵與地方部隊，轉向使用蘇聯坦克、炮兵、雷達防空武器與MiG戰鬥機的機械化軍隊；但北部山區限制了裝甲與航空優勢，長距離公路補給也使每次攻勢承擔高昂風險。1977至1978年索馬利亞與埃塞俄比亞交戰後，蘇聯把主要援助轉向埃塞俄比亞，外部援助平衡因而逆轉。1980年代末，援助又隨蘇聯及周邊國家政策改變而收縮，PLA因長期保留作戰單位、熟悉道路與建立山地供應點而逐漸取得主動。政治上，戰爭使EPLF成為新國家的主要軍事與行政力量，也成為埃塞俄比亞內戰中的決定性因素之一；1991年5月，EPLF在北部迫使軍委政府撤出厄立特里亞的同時，以人民革命民主陣線為首的反軍委聯盟進入亞的斯亞貝巴。厄立特里亞戰線並非單獨推翻軍委，卻加速了其軍事、聯盟與合法性困境，並把一場跨越三十年的武裝鬥爭轉化為新國家的主權問題。
impactEn: Militarily, the war transformed short-lived, dispersed guerrilla cells into a PLA capable of sustaining operations for three decades. The merger of the ELM and ELF gradually centralized political direction, military command, logistics, and foreign liaison. By the final phase, the PLA could conduct battalion-level assaults, support infantry with artillery, launch armored counterattacks, and seize equipment in successive operations. The OLF developed a separate force in the west based more heavily on mobile guerrilla action and attacks on towns. Ethiopia was transformed as well. The imperial army evolved from reliance mainly on infantry and local units into a mechanized force using Soviet tanks, artillery, air-defense weapons, and MiG fighters. Rugged northern terrain nevertheless restricted the advantage of armor and aviation, while long road-supply lines made every offensive expensive. After the Somali–Ethiopian war of 1977 and 1978, the Soviet Union redirected most assistance toward Ethiopia, reversing the balance of foreign support. Late in the 1980s, that assistance contracted as Soviet and neighboring regional policies changed. The PLA gained the initiative because it retained combat units, learned the roads, and established mountain supply points. Politically, the war made the EPLF the principal military and administrative force of the new state and one of the decisive factors in the wider Ethiopian conflict. In May 1991, the EPLF forced the Derg government out of Eritrea in the north while the EPRDF-led opposition entered Addis Ababa. The Eritrean front did not alone overthrow the Derg, but it accelerated the regime's military, alliance, and legitimacy crises and converted a thirty-year armed struggle into a question of sovereignty for a new state.
result: 軍事結果不是政府軍在厄立特里亞全數被殲滅，而是其在北部戰區失去可持續防守的兵力與據點。1989年PLA控制凱倫、1990年政府軍放棄馬薩瓦與阿薩布的最後據點後，阿斯馬拉外圍只剩下機場及市區內少數陣地；1991年5月24日，PLA占領這些最後陣地，聯邦政府的軍事行政機構在厄立特里亞終止，當日成立臨時政府。EPLF主導最後攻勢並達成由武裝鬥爭爭取厄立特里亞獨立的主要目標，但OLF在西部長期進行的平行戰役與外部支持同樣構成壓力，戰後它對EPLF主導的過渡安排提出不同主張。獨立並非由軍方單方面宣布即告完成：1993年公投以官方統計的百分之九十九點八贊成及百分之九十四點七投票率確認獨立，5月24日正式建國，5月28日加入聯合國。從1961年第一聲槍響到1991年阿斯馬拉易手，軍事勝負是明確的；至於整場戰爭的傷亡、失蹤與被俘總數，由於紀錄分散且雙方採用的統計基準不同，沒有可信的單一精確數字。
resultEn: The military result was not the total destruction of Ethiopian forces in Eritrea, but the loss of troops and positions that the government could continue to defend there. After the PLA took Keren in 1989 and the government abandoned its last positions around Massawa and Assab in 1990, only the airport and a few positions inside Asmara remained outside rebel control in the capital. On 24 May 1991, the PLA occupied those final positions, the federal military administration in Eritrea ended, and a provisional government was established that day. The EPLF led the final offensive and achieved the central military objective of the armed movement for Eritrean independence, while the OLF's parallel campaigns in the west and its external assistance also applied sustained pressure; after the war, it took a different position toward the EPLF-led transitional arrangement. Independence was not completed by a unilateral military declaration. A 1993 referendum confirmed independence with an official vote of 99.8 percent in favor and a turnout of 94.7 percent. Eritrea formally became a state on 24 May and joined the United Nations on 28 May. From the first shots fired in 1961 to the change of control in Asmara in 1991, the military outcome was clear. A single precise total for deaths, missing personnel, and prisoners across the entire war cannot be responsibly stated because the surviving records are fragmentary and the two sides used different counting methods.
